Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner concluded that the 2004 film The Prince & Me was directed by Catherine Cyran based on a misleading search snippet, without verifying via reliable sources (e.g., opening the Wikipedia/IMDb pages). This conflated the sequel’s director (Cyran) with the original 2004 film, which was directed by Martha Coolidge.
